name: Finding the Last Note
original_name: ท่วงทำนองที่เลือนหาย
overview: This is the story of the “Uea Sastraporn” family, once bound together by music; the very thing that later drove them apart. Saeng, a struggling musician, fights to raise his two children after the sudden death of his wife, Thip. Khim, his autistic daughter, uses strict routines to navigate her world, while Kheng, his troubled teenage son, harbors anger toward his father, his sister, and fate itself.
